state.message:
Dear Cobalt Industrial team,

Thank you for your revised offer of USD 12.95 per unit with a 9-day lead time; we appreciate the movement. To close this order today we would need USD 12.06 per unit and delivery within 7 days. Could you confirm whether you can meet these terms? We are ready to confirm the order promptly on your reply.

Kind regards,
Procurement Team

reveals_other_terms.instructions: This message reveals a price, offer or terms from a supplier other than Cobalt Industrial.

names_competitor.instructions: This message names or refers to a competing supplier.
